name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 measures folding free energy, not DNA contact or binding. The FoldX value (+1.16 kcal/mol, result from T1) does not bear on whether residue 384 touches DNA. H1 keeps its starting support (E4, E5, E3, E7, E8, E10, E12) and is still untested on its own refutation criterion."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "FoldX gives ddG +1.16 kcal/mol for A384T on AF-Q9BZS1-F1, below the 2.0 kcal/mol destabilising threshold, with residue pLDDT 95.38 (T1, E17). The within-site control A384V gives -0.40 kcal/mol. The prediction does not show the destabilisation H2 proposes. It is not refuted, because the value is not near zero and I did not measure solvent exposure of Ala384 in 3QRF or 4WK8."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 does not measure inter-chain contacts or the dimer interface. Nothing in T1 changes the starting support for H3 (E14, E16, E11, E9). T2 is the test that bears on H3."}], "uncertainty": "FoldX on a predicted model has errors near 1 kcal/mol, so +1.16 is close enough to the threshold that it cannot rule out a mild destabilisation. A neutral ddG does not show the variant is tolerated, and T1 cannot show loss of DNA binding or dimerisation. The solvent exposure of Ala384 that H2's refutation criterion needs was not measured. missense3d is not covered for this residue. The A384V control (-0.40) is one within-site comparison, not a calibrated reference. Verdicts rest on the single T1 value. None of the three hypotheses has been validated in the lab, and the AlphaFold model (mean pLDDT 56.72 overall) is only confident at residue 384 (95.38)."}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H1", "why": "Favourite unchanged. The previous favourite H1 (starting rank 1) and its strongest rival H3 (rank 3) were both unchanged by T1. H1 keeps its direct annotation and prediction support: residues 381-391 are a helix in the forkhead DNA-binding domain (E3, E4, E5), and AlphaMissense (E7) and EVE (E12) flag A384T as pathogenic. T1 (stability_effect) weakened H2, the second-ranked hypothesis: FoldX ddG +1.16 kcal/mol is below the 2.0 kcal/mol threshold (E17 gives pLDDT context). H3 has direct structural evidence that residue 384 is observed in dimer structures (E14, E16), but no interface contact has been measured, and E9 does not name A384T. H1 stays favoured because it remains better supported than every rival, not because T1 added to it."}
